name: modfarm/world
label: World
description: Present published Series world content and optionally Books as sections or accessible tabs.

placement.auto: Current Series archive, otherwise Book with exactly one Series
placement.manual: seriesId selected by Series name in editor

visibility: Only Published worlds and Published Public entries. Internal notes and Members entries never render. Legacy content defaults to Draft.
emptyBehavior: Omit empty sections and their tabs; omit the complete block when no eligible content or reader-unlockable content exists.
dependencies: ModFarm Core World Bible presentation v2
ModFarm Theme Book Archive List for included Books
sideEffects: None. Placing a block never publishes content or rewrites archive patterns.
